entries.before: We primarily derive revenues from monthly membership fees for services related to streaming content to our members. We offer a variety of streaming membership plans, the price of which varies by country and the features of the plan. As of June 30, 2026, pricing on our plans ranged from the U.S. dollar equivalent of $1 to $38 per month, and pricing on our extra member sub accounts ranged from the U.S. dollar equivalent of $2 to $10 per month. We expect that from time to time the prices of our membership plans in each country may change and we may test other plan and price variations.
entries.after: We primarily derive revenues from monthly subscription fees for services related to streaming content to our members. We offer a variety of streaming plans, including our ad-supported subscription, with multiple pricing tiers that vary by country and the features of the plan. As of September 30, 2026, pricing on our streaming plans ranged from the U.S. dollar equivalent of $1 to $37 per month, and pricing on our extra member accounts ranged from the U.S. dollar equivalent of $2 to $10 per month. We expect that from time to time the prices of our streaming plans in each country may change and we may test other plan and price variations. The prices of our streaming plans, and periodic changes to these prices, may impact growth in memberships and the plans that both new and existing members choose, including the number of members that select our ad-supported subscription.
